title: Event A5 (SpCell becomes worse than threshold1 and neighbour becomes better than threshold2)

entities.name: Event A5
entities.description: Measurement event triggered when serving cell (SpCell) becomes worse than threshold1 and neighbor cell becomes better than threshold2.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that performs measurement reporting according to network configuration.

entities.name: SpCell
entities.description: Serving cell whose quality is measured against threshold1.

entities.name: Neighbour Cell
entities.description: Adjacent cell whose quality is measured against threshold2.

entities.name: Threshold1
entities.description: Quality threshold for serving cell below which Event A5 condition is partially met.

entities.name: Threshold2
entities.description: Quality threshold for neighbor cell above which Event A5 condition is partially met.

relations.description: Event A5 condition requires serving cell quality to be worse than threshold1.
Event A5 condition requires neighbor cell quality to be better than threshold2.
Event A5 condition uses threshold1 as comparison value for serving cell quality.
Event A5 condition uses threshold2 as comparison value for neighbor cell quality.
UE performs measurement reporting when Event A5 condition is met.
